capabilities: Plan days, weeks, months, and years.
Generate daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly notes.
Display timed to-dos in a calendar view.
extras: Closed source plugin with a Pro tier requiring a one-time purchase and key activation.
problem: Users need a structured way to manage long-term planning, habits, and reviews directly within their Markdown notes without relying on external dedicated planning software.
summary: Planfold is a Markdown-based planner that allows users to organize daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly schedules, to-dos, moods, and habits within Obsidian.
